description: Configure automatic product image watermarking for the Main Website. You have a watermark file located at '/home/ga/Documents/watermark.png'. Navigate to Content > Design > Configuration, edit the 'Main Website' scope, and configure the 'Product Image Watermarks' section. Upload the watermark file for Base, Small, and Thumbnail images. Set the Opacity to 20% and Position to 'Center' for all three image types. Save the configuration. If not logged in, use admin/Admin1234!.
